verdict.rationale: Whisper is a speech-recognition model, shipped as an open-source library and CLI and as a transcription API endpoint. It is not an end-user application that could host a built-in assistant for delegating tasks, so this axis is a category error for it. Nothing in the evidence shows Whisper shipping any assistant or task-delegation feature; the evidence covers only transcription, translation and language identification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
